$comment: Memory schema, matching the on-disk format of lia-cli/data/memory/lia-memory.vault.json so the two can share a store without migration.

graph.note: Not provisioned. The schema below is what to load once a store exists; there is no graph running on this machine today.

encryption.passphrase_note: Never in this repo. Source from a 0600 file outside the tree.

persistence_contract: A fact written in one session must be readable in the next with no model in between.
Public entries are plaintext. Hidden are filtered at query. Encrypted are sealed at write.
The graph is a cache over the JSON store, never the system of record.
